axe_findings.title: Links rely on color to be distinguishable.
axe_findings.description: Low-contrast text is difficult or impossible for many users to read. Link text that is discernible improves the experience for users with low vision. [Learn how to make links distinguishable](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/link-in-text-block).

items.snippet: <a href="https://www.hhs.gov/" class="ext" data-extlink="" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow noreferrer">
items.node_label: Department of Health and Human Services
items.explanation:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.31:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #dfe1e2, surrounding text: #ffffff)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text

axe_findings.title: Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing.
axe_findings.description: Touch targets with sufficient size and spacing help users who may have difficulty targeting small controls to activate the targets. [Learn more about touch targets](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/target-size).

axe_findings.title: Document does not have a main landmark.
axe_findings.description: One main landmark helps screen reader users navigate a web page. [Learn more about landmarks](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/landmark-one-main).

items.explanation:
Fix all of the following:
  Document does not have a main landmark

axe_findings.title: Elements with visible text labels do not have matching accessible names.
axe_findings.description: Visible text labels that do not match the accessible name can result in a confusing experience for screen reader users. [Learn more about accessible names](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.12/label-content-name-mismatch).
